parsed.answer: For Cobalt’s next outage, Ivo should use REPLAY-1-632—the recovery procedure validated on August 8. The delivery-mode change was caused by the GATE-1-519 outages recorded on August 8; on August 15 Ivo approved switching Cobalt from BATCH-1-741 to STREAM-1-286.

citations.quote: For the next outage, use the recovery procedure validated on August 8.
The team tested REPLAY-1-632, which restored the missing updates.
Ivo approved switching Cobalt from BATCH-1-741 to STREAM-1-286.
The cause was the GATE-1-519 outages recorded on August 8
